name: Cloudflare Durable Objects
tagline: Single-threaded stateful actors at the edge, each with its own strongly consistent SQLite store.
description: Durable Objects give each instance of a class a globally unique ID, a single-threaded execution context and its own private storage, now an embedded SQLite database with point-in-time recovery. Because every request for a given object is routed to one place, you get strong consistency and simple coordination without locks: chat rooms, multiplayer game state, rate limiters, collaborative documents and per-tenant databases are the classic uses. WebSocket hibernation keeps idle connections cheap. The model scales by creating many objects, not by making one object big, so throughput per object is limited and data modelling has to follow that.

pricing.startingPrice: $0.15 per million requests beyond 1M/month on Workers Paid
pricing.notes: Free plan allows SQLite-backed objects with daily limits; paid plan bills requests, GB-s duration, rows read/written and $0.20 per GB-month stored.

scale.notes: Scales out across millions of independent objects; each object lives in one location (with optional jurisdiction or location hints) and holds up to 10 GB.

strengths: Strong consistency per object with no locking code: one thread, one owner
Each object gets a private SQLite database with transactions and indexes
WebSocket hibernation makes real-time apps cheap when idle
Alarms API for scheduled per-object work
weaknesses: Throughput per object is bounded by a single thread
No cross-object transactions or queries; aggregation needs fan-out
Object placement is fixed near first access, so far-away users see extra latency
useCases: Chat rooms and collaborative editing backends
Coordinating AI agents with durable state
notIdealFor: Global analytical queries across all data
A single very hot entity needing high write throughput
Workloads that must run outside Cloudflare
